definitions.artifact_compile_consumer: every action removes only its isolated temporary target and performs a clean cargo check --locked --offline
definitions.packed_owned: reused owned packed buffers including pack, multiply and unpack
definitions.packed_view: caller-owned aligned storage including pack, borrowed-view multiply and unpack
definitions.compact_snapshot: compact MFSG state without retained source items
definitions.tracked_snapshot: MFTS state with exact retained source items and full restore validation
definitions.failure_path: malformed journals must be rejected without publishing partial state

limitations: Smoke results from a dirty interactive host are not publication claims
two workers and five observations per worker validate the harness but do not replace Controlled replication
allocation is expected in end-to-end wire, runtime, tracked and journal operations
child-process allocations performed by cargo/rustc are outside the in-process allocation counter
performance comparisons require equal scales, payloads, strategies and dedicated hosts
